fields.label: Archive contents
fields.text: linear/{ttp,client}_chunk00..10.tsv and diagonal/{ttp,client}_chunk00..10.tsv (44 TSV files, 367,315,945 bytes uncompressed in total), LICENSE_CC_BY (19,467 B), README (297 B). Zip CRC32s were recorded by lane A (they match V2, see below).

fields.label: Format declared
fields.text: '<uint8 c>\t<double t>' ; c = timetagger channel, t = photon arrival time in ns

fields.label: Content declared
fields.text: Timetags that lead to coincidence count events in a 3ns window for Client and TTP, for linear (commitment to M0) and diagonal (M1) basis.

fields.label: Caveats
items: Pre-filtered to coincidence-producing events (3 ns window). It's not the full raw stream, so singles-based loss can't be estimated from it.
The Client channel meaning (H/+ vs V/-) depends on which folder (linear/diagonal) the file is in.
